title.en: Does it belong to this domain?

hints.tr: `host == domain or host.endswith("." + domain)`; noktasız `endswith` `notschool.example`'ı da kabul eder.
hints.en: `host == domain or host.endswith("." + domain)`; `endswith` without the dot also accepts `notschool.example`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


def belongs_to(url, domain):
    host = urlsplit(url).hostname or ""
    domain = domain.lower()
    return host == domain or host.endswith("." + domain)

for url in ["https://login.school.example/a", "https://school.example.evil.test/a",
            "https://notschool.example/a", "https://school.example/"]:
    print(belongs_to(url, "school.example"))
```
